title: Seven Palms Retreat
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Seven Palms Retreat”, a luxury 7-bed, 7.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 32 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Elevator & Golf Cart. Book your beach getaway now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Gulf Views - Private Resort-Style Pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Elevator - 6 Seater Golf Cart Included - 6 Adult Bicycles Included - Short Walk to the Beach Beautifully curated, this sleek, luxurious beachside retreat is a true masterpiece, perfectly situated just a stone’s throw away from the pristine Gulf waters. Boasting an impressive vertical elevation adorned with white-washed parapet walls and captivating architectural features, including a fourth-story lookout deck, this home is a remarkable sight. The mindfulness and craftsmanship in its new construction are truly remarkable. As you step inside, you’ll be greeted by the sheer elegance and comfort this home exudes. A private elevator ensures easy access to all levels, making this property exceptionally convenient. The resort-style pool and spa, accompanied by a generously sized rear pool deck with fenced privacy, offer an oasis of relaxation. A summer kitchen invites you to indulge in culinary delights while basking in the coastal breeze. With four levels of meticulously designed porch space, you can soak in the endless Gulf views and relish breathtaking sunset vistas each evening. This retreat is the epitome of coastal luxury living. This expansive residence accommodates up to 32 guests across its four sumptuous vertical levels, making it the perfect escape for large gatherings, especially during the summer season. The open floorplan seamlessly integrates a spacious living room, a chef’s dream kitchen, and an inviting dining area, all with picturesque views of the adjacent resort-style amenities, including a covered outdoor kitchen, a private pool and spa, garage parking, and an outdoor shower for added convenience. The ground floor offers a welcoming space for entertainment. You’ll also find a ping pong table, a refrigerator, and glass doors that lead out to the pool. Two bedrooms, a king suite, and a bunk room, provide comfortable sleeping arrangements on this level. Ascending the stairs or taking the elevator to the main level, you’ll be greeted by soaring vaulted ceilings and an abundance of natural light. The kitchen is a culinary masterpiece with a vast quartz-topped island, custom inlaid vent hood, and premier appliances, including a double Sub-Zero refrigerator and a gas Wolf range. There’s ample seating at the island and two expansive formal dining tables for hosting memorable gatherings. The main living area, with its plush seating and bespoke fixtures and modern fireplace offers a seamless blend of comfort and style, and a wet bar is thoughtfully designed for crafting fresh cocktails. Step outside through the glass doors to discover a cozy outdoor lounge space and an alfresco dining table. This level also offers two private bedrooms—a bunk room and a king suite—along with a laundry room and a convenient powder room. On the penthouse level, you’ll find two elegant king suites, each with a full ensuite bathroom and custom built-in bunk spaces. Another laundry room and a final living area with a wet bar complete this level. The primary suite on the third level offers Gulf views and direct access to the southeast-facing covered deck, with an ascending staircase leading to the panoramic views from the fourth-floor tower. The suite includes a king-size bed, a spacious ensuite bathroom with a double vanity, soaking tub, walk- in closet, and a step-in shower. Back on the ground level, the sun-kissed, resort-style pool beckons relaxation and recreation. Shaded lounge space, a gas grill and outdoor dining space provide endless options for enjoyment. A unique upholstered pool couch in the shallow platform of the pool adds a touch of luxury and comfort. When it’s time to hit the beach, you’ll have two convenient access points within walking or biking distance of your front door. For added convenience and adventure, this property includes a 6-Seater Golf Cart and 6 Adult Bicycles, allowing you to explore the surrounding area and make the most of your coastal getaway. This beachside retreat is a haven of luxury, comfort, and coastal charm, making it the ideal destination for those seeking the ultimate beachfront experience. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: King Bedroom with private bathroom, shower only Bunkroom w/ Two Queen over Queen bunks w/ shared bathroom, Shower/Tub combo Second Floor: King Bedroom with private bathroom, shower only Bunkroom w/ Two Queen over Queen bunks w/ private bathroom, shower only Half Bathroom Third Floor: King Bedroom, with Queen over Queen Bunk, private bathroom w/ shower only King Bedroom, with Twin over Twin Bunk, private bathroom w/ shower only Master King Bedroom, private bathroom w/ separate Shower/Tub Half Bathroom
